title: Sails TradeCommitmentV1 (E25) + ArbitrationCommitmentV1 (E26) conformance vectors, v1
note: Shared by the server (src/modules/open-p2p/trade-commitment.ts, arbitration-commitment.ts) and the SDK (packages/sails-sdk/src/modules/). Rails named EXAMPLE_* and railCapability are TEST FIXTURES, not classifications of real rails; the production B5 enabled-rail set is empty (HOLD). Timestamps in receivedAt are the verifying server clock. An absent maker/taker key means that role has not signed.

tradeCases.name: valid: both roles signed the same digest in time -> COMMITTED
taker signed only -> PARTIALLY_SIGNED (never COMMITTED)
maker signed only -> PARTIALLY_SIGNED (never COMMITTED)
no signature -> PROPOSED
maker signature checked with the taker role (T9): taker slot carries the maker signature
signature over the swapped-tag digest (T8) is refused
rail changed after signing (INV-4): signatures over the MULTISIG digest on a WDK_USDT_EVM commitment
anchorRef changed after signing (replay on another anchor)
non-canonical S (S + L) is refused although tweetnacl accepts it
amount not in the canonical 8-place form ("0.005")
control character in offerLogicalId
unknown (unsigned) field is refused, never ignored
uppercase anchorRef is not canonical
same party on both roles
declared digest differs from the recomputed one
offer revision differs from the accepted envelope
expiresAt after the envelope expiry
amount above the offer max
B5 HOLD: empty enabled-rail set refuses every rail
fee policy does not reproduce the committed digest (rate rotated)
second signature received exactly at expiresAt (exclusive limit)

termsCases.name: valid UNAVAILABLE (known: rail has no arbitration)
valid DYNAMIC_REASSIGNABLE (pool hash, no algorithm: D-k HOLD)
REFUSED UNKNOWN with arbiterRef NONE (pattern rejected by the CTO)
REFUSED UNAVAILABLE with a concrete arbiter
REFUSED capability != rail-derived (object FIXED, rail classified UNAVAILABLE)
REFUSED FIXED promising an appeal on the current script
expect: E26_CONTRADICTORY_ARBITRATION_TERMS:appeal(none may be promised on the current script)

termsCases.name: REFUSED FIXED promising liveness on the current script (R6)
REFUSED invalid capability value (ordered list: every rule it breaks)

pairCases.name: valid FIXED pair: four signatures -> COMMITTED
valid UNAVAILABLE pair (rail known to have no arbitration) -> COMMITTED
valid UNKNOWN pair -> COMMITTED (escrow creation in UNKNOWN stays refused: F4/B5)
taker signed the trade but not the E26 object -> refused, not partially accepted
maker signed the E26 object but not the trade -> refused
E26 window differs from the commitment (expiresAt)
E26 points at another commitment digest
E26 on another rail than its commitment
E26 policy digest does not match its policy document
contradictory terms reach the pair verdict with the ordered rule list
E26 signature over the trade-tagged bytes (swapped tag) is refused
E26 maker signature reused as the trade maker signature (cross-object replay)
E26 control character in a policy field
E26 taker signature carries another receipt than its trade signature (one action, one server stamp)
E26 declared digest differs from the recomputed one
